topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: Oh wow, can you believe it? Ms. Clara from next door just came over, all smiles and sunshine, and she’s asking if she can set up a little garden in a corner of our yard. I mean, I knew she’s into all that green thumb stuff, but our yard? She’s talking about tomatoes and herbs, and I’m just standing there, nodding like a bobblehead. Part of me is thinking, "Sure, why not? More tomatoes!" But another part is like, "Wait, what’s happening?" I told her I’d need some time to think about it. She was so sweet, handed me a homemade cookie, and everything. I’m just not sure what to make of it, you know?
